source: The First Choshu Expedition has ended with a whimper, rather than a roar. Under the leadership of Saigo Takamori, a light punishment has been enforced, and several retainers of Choshu have committed seppuku to apologize for the Kinmon Incident.
current_cn: 第一次长州远征是在一声呜咽中结束的，而不是一声咆哮。在西乡隆盛的带领下，实行了轻刑，多名长州家臣纷纷切腹，为禁门之变道歉。

source: Choshu has forced back the Shogunate forces, showing the weakness of the Shogunate more clearly than ever before.
current_cn: 长州将幕府势力逼退，幕府的弱点比以往任何时候都更加明显。

source: Choshu's assault on Kyoto has ended in defeat. Repelled at the Forbidden Gates, the domain is now condemned as a rebel force. With imperial approval secured, the Shogunate has called its allied domains to arms and begun a grand punitive campaign. If they crush Choshu's remaining resistance, the Bakufu's authority will be restored across Japan.
current_cn: 长州进攻京都以失败告终。该藩在禁门被击退，现在被谴责为叛军。在获得天皇批准后，幕府已号召其盟国武装起来，并开始了一场大规模的惩罚性战役。如果他们粉碎了长州剩余的抵抗，幕府的权威将在日本各地恢复。

source: The Genji loyalists have been crushed, and the Shogunate’s authority stands unshaken. The reformist leaders have been executed or driven into hiding, while the conservative factions reassert their dominance in Choshu. Any hope of Choshu once again opposing the Shogunate is gone.
current_cn: 源氏的忠诚者已被镇压，幕府的权威丝毫没有动摇。改革派领导人要么被处决，要么被迫躲藏起来，而保守派则重新确立了他们在长州的统治地位。长州再次反抗幕府的希望已经破灭。

source: The Seigi-ha have risen up at Kosanji Temple, challenging the conservative faction in Choshu, who have been cracking down on the radicals ever since the domain's loss in the First Choshu Expedition.
current_cn: 清仪派在高山寺崛起，挑战长州的保守派，自第一次长州远征以来，长州的保守派一直在镇压激进分子。

source: The Kosanji rebels have prevailed, and Choshu will once again reject the Shogunate’s authority. The conservatives have all been purged or cast aside, and the sonno joi have once again taken power in Choshu.
current_cn: 耕三寺叛军取得了胜利，长州将再次拒绝幕府的权威。保守派全部被清洗或被抛弃，尊王党再次在长州掌权。

source: The Tengu-to Rebels have failed, and the Shogunate will remain open to foreigners. The ringleaders have been executed or forced to commit seppuku, and the Conservatives shall rule in Mito.
current_cn: 天狗岛叛军失败了，幕府仍将向外国人开放。头目已被处决或被迫切腹，保守党将统治水户。

source: The Tengu-to Rebels have won out. While the Shogunate remains open to foreigners, Mito has unified around the Sonno-joi.
current_cn: 天狗岛叛军取得了胜利。虽然幕府仍然对外国人开放，但水户已经统一在尊王攘夷周围。

source: It is hereby announced that His Majesty has passed from this life and joined the Imperial Ancestors. The Heir Apparent has now assumed the Throne. All domains and officials shall observe mourning and maintain order.
current_cn: 特此宣布陛下已圆寂，归入太祖。法定继承人现已登上王位。各藩、各官员应当默哀，维持秩序。

source: On the 29th day of the 8th month, the Shōgun, {oldShogun}, passed away at Osaka Castle. By solemn decree of the Bakufu, a mourning period has been declared, and military operations are paused to honor his memory. His successor, {newShogun}, has been named, with authority confirmed by senior officials.
current_cn: 八月二十九日，将军{oldShogun}在大阪城去世。根据幕府的幕府法令，宣布哀悼期，并暂停军事行动以纪念他。他的继任者 {newShogun} 已被任命，并得到了高级官员的确认。

source: The {Reform} have begun, as various domains have begun refining their militaries once more into a more modern form.
current_cn: {Reform} 已经开始，各藩再次着手将军队整编为更加现代化的形态。

source: By mutual resolve, the leaders of Satsuma and Choshu have entered into a secret pact to unite their strength in service of restoring Imperial authority. From this day forward, both domains stand as one in purpose against the rule of the shogunate.
current_cn: 通过共同的决心，萨摩和长州的领导人达成了一项秘密协议，以联合他们的力量来恢复帝国的权威。从今天起，这两个藩将成为一体，共同反对幕府的统治。

source: The Second Choshu Expedition has ended with the success of the Bakufu. Choshu has been thoroughly crushed, never to rise again, and the Bakufu has shown to the world that it is not weak.
current_cn: 第二次长州远征随着幕府的胜利而结束。长州已被彻底击垮，再也无法崛起，而幕府向世人表明了它的不弱。

source: The Shogunate has formally declared a second punitive expedition against the Choshu domain, ordering its allied forces to advance at once in response to Choshu's continued defiance and failure to comply with shogunal commands.
current_cn: 幕府正式宣布对长州藩进行第二次讨伐，命令其联军立即进军，以回应长州的持续蔑视和不遵守幕府命令。

source: Despite being outnumbered, Choshu has achieved a crushing victory against the forces of the Bakufu. Their modern infantry has proven superior over the half-hearted reforms of the Bakufu. The Shogunate is weak, and the wolves have begun to gather.
current_cn: 尽管寡不敌众，长州还是取得了对幕府军队的压倒性胜利。事实证明，他们的现代步兵优于幕府半心半意的改革。幕府衰弱，狼群开始聚集。

source: It is hereby proclaimed that the administration of the realm has been respectfully returned to the Imperial Throne. The Shogun, having fulfilled his charge, has retired from his offices. Henceforth, all affairs of state shall proceed under the direct and august authority of His Majesty.
current_cn: 特此宣布，国家行政权已重新归还给帝国王座。幕府将军完成了他的职责后，已经从办公室退休了。从此以后，所有国家事务都将在国王陛下的直接和威严的权力下进行。

source: Battle has ignited at Toba–Fushimi between newly declared Imperial troops and the Shogunate. The peace is broken, and both sides call upon their allies. All domains will be expected to declare their stance.
current_cn: 新宣布的帝国军队与幕府之间的战斗在鸟羽伏见爆发。和平被打破，双方都呼吁盟友。所有藩都应声明其立场。

current_cn: 部落每天失去 1 点影响力{newline}定居点的税收收入增加 15%{newline}每个显着收益每天对定居点所有者部落产生 -.15 影响力

source: I was wondering when I would find you, {PLAYER.NAME}. Chōshū moves, and yet somehow you are always close to the fault lines when things begin to break. Convenient... or intentional, I wonder. I am {LORD.NAME}.[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]
current_cn: 我想知道什么时候能找到你，{PLAYER.NAME}。长州在移动，但不知何故，当事情开始破裂时，你总是接近断层线。我想知道是方便……还是故意的。我是 {LORD.NAME}.[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]

source: You have heard of the Zokuron-ha, no doubt. Men who no longer serve our lord, but instead interpret his will until it no longer resembles his own. It is a quieter coup than steel in the night, but no less real.{newline}{newline}Chōshū cannot afford to be governed by shadows wearing official seals. So I have begun what some will call an uprising, but is in truth an attempt to save our lord.{newline}{newline}I am not here to beg you, {PLAYER.NAME}. I am here because {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\\?} like you do not stand safely on the fence forever. You either act while there is still something worth acting for... or you watch it rot past saving.[if:grave][ib:warrior]
current_cn: 毫无疑问，你听说过 Zokuron-ha。这些人不再侍奉我们的主，而是解释他的意志，直到它不再像他自己的意志。这是比夜里的钢铁更安静的政变，但同样真实。{newline}{newline}长州不能被戴着官方印章的阴影所统治。所以我开始了一些人所说的起义，但实际上是为了拯救我们的领主。{newline}{newline}我不是来这里求你的，{PLAYER.NAME}。我来这里是因为 {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\\?} 像你一样不会永远安全地站在栅栏上。你要么在仍有值得为之行动的事情时行动……要么眼睁睁地看着它腐烂而无法挽救。[if:grave][ib:warrior]

source: Good. I did not misjudge you, {PLAYER.NAME}. Chōshū will need men who act, not hesitate.
current_cn: 好的。我没有误判你，{PLAYER.NAME}。长州需要毫不犹豫地行动的人。

source: Conflict is inevitable against those who claim to march under the Imperial Banner.
current_cn: 对于那些声称在帝国旗帜下游行的人来说，冲突是不可避免的。

source: Conflict is inevitable against those who march under the Shogun's Banner.
current_cn: 对于那些在将军旗帜下游行的人来说，冲突是不可避免的。

source: Your father was a court noble, advising the emperor himself. While he held no actual power, none dared touch him, and even Daimyo would turn their ears to listen when he spoke. He made his living tutoring noble sons, and he taught you alongside them.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位宫廷贵族，亲自为皇帝提供建议。他虽然没有实权，却没有人敢碰他，就连大名也会侧耳倾听。他以辅导贵族子弟为生，并与他们一起教导你。

source: Your father was a hatamoto, a direct retainer of the Tokugawa Shoguns themselves. One of the roughly five thousand hatamoto spread throughout Japan, he held an administrative rank in the Bakufu, administering a village on behalf of the Shogun.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位旗本，是德川幕府将军的直属家臣。他是遍布日本的大约五千人之一，在幕府担任行政职务，代表幕府管理一个村庄。

source: Your father was a ranking domain samurai in the service of his daimyo. Stationed in the castle town, he spent most of his time working in the bureaucracy, alongside regular martial training.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位为他的大名服务的等级藩士。他驻扎在城下町，大部分时间都在官僚机构工作，同时也定期进行武术训练。

source: Your father was a humble but skilled swordsmith who through his physical strength and mastery of his art was able to transform raw metal into sharp blades, making him well known in his domain for the quality of his creations. Even as a child, by helping him in the forge, you were able to absorb some of his craftmanship and harden your body.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位谦虚但技艺高超的剑匠，凭借他的体力和精湛的技艺，他能够将原始金属转化为锋利的刀片，使他在他的藩中因其创作的质量而闻名。即使在小时候，通过帮助他锻造，你也能够吸收他的一些手艺并锻炼你的身体。

source: You spent much of your youth at the domain school, learning etiquette, the classics, rhetoric, and of course swordsmanship. You spend your days drilling forms and sparring under the watchful eyes of senior retainers. Though still young, the constant practice hardened your body and sharpened your instincts in close combat.
current_cn: 你年轻时的大部分时间都在藩校里度过，学习礼仪、经典、辞藻，当然还有剑术。你每天都在高级随从的注视下练习表格和陪练。虽然还年轻，但不断的练习锻炼了你的身体，磨砺了你的近战本能。

source: You spent long hours copying reports and tax ledgers for domain officials. The work was tedious but taught you careful bookkeeping and administrative discipline.
current_cn: 您花了很长时间为藩官员复制报告和税务分类帐。这项工作很乏味，但教会了你仔细的记账和行政纪律。

source: Thanks to your high social rank, you were able to train in Bajutsu, learning the sword and bow. While your position was more symbolic than anything, you still learned well.
current_cn: 由于你的社会地位很高，你能够接受巴术训练，学习剑和弓。虽然你的立场比任何事情都更具象征意义，但你仍然学到了很多东西。

source: You spent your youth as a Hikyaku, a member of the Bakufu's courier network. You constantly travelled back and forth along the highways of Japan, always speeding to your next destination.
current_cn: 你的青年时代是作为一名飞脚度过的，他是幕府快递网络的一员。你不断地沿着日本的高速公路来回穿梭，总是飞驰着前往下一个目的地。

source: The arrival of the Black Ships was an unforgivable insult to the realm. Like many hot-blooded patriots, you embraced the cry of sonnō jōi: revere the Emperor, expel the barbarians. Whether through secret meetings, militant drilling, or open defiance of the shogunate's policy of compromise, you prepared yourself for the day the outsiders would be driven from Japan's shores.
current_cn: 黑船的到来对藩国来说是不可原谅的侮辱。你们和许多热血爱国志士一样，拥抱着尊皇、驱逐夷狄的“尊皇逐夷”的呼声。无论是通过秘密会议、军事演习，还是公开蔑视幕府的妥协政策，你都为外来者被赶出日本海岸的那一天做好了准备。

source: you supported unity between court and shogunate.
current_cn: 你支持朝廷和幕府的统一。

source: The turmoil stirred by the Black Ships threatened to tear the country apart. Rather than embrace reckless extremism, you supported the policy of kōbu gattai: Unification of the Imperial Court and Bakufu. Through careful service and measured loyalty, you worked to preserve order in an age that seemed determined to abandon it.
current_cn: 黑船引发的骚乱威胁着国家的分裂。您没有拥抱鲁莽的极端主义，而是支持“宫部合体”政策：宫廷与幕府的统一。通过细心的服务和谨慎的忠诚，你们努力在一个似乎决心放弃秩序的时代维持秩序。

source: The thunder of foreign cannon along Japan's coasts demanded action. In your domain, new militias and shore batteries were raised in haste. You threw yourself into drilling men, moving supplies, and preparing for the invasion many believed inevitable.
current_cn: 日本沿海的外国炮火轰鸣，要求采取行动。在你的管辖范围内，新的民兵和海岸炮台正在匆忙中组建。你全身心投入到训练人员、运送物资以及为许多人认为不可避免的入侵做准备的工作中。

source: When the Black Ships appeared and the country trembled, you saw not fear but opportunity. While domains argued and officials scrambled, you joined rough men who profited from the confusion: smuggling, raiding poorly guarded storehouses, and waylaying those too slow to adapt. You became skilled at striking quickly and disappearing just as fast. Though many would call you little better than a bandit, you know you simply survived where others hesitated.
current_cn: 当黑船出现、国家颤抖时，你看到的不是恐惧，而是机遇。当藩发生争执、官员争先恐后时，你却加入了从混乱中获利的粗暴之徒：走私、袭击守卫薄弱的仓库，以及伏击那些行动迟缓而无法适应的仓库。你变得擅长快速攻击和快速消失。尽管很多人会说你比强盗好不了多少，但你知道你只是在其他人犹豫不决的时候活了下来。

source: While others chose sides in the growing turmoil of the age, you kept to your own affairs. Neither strongly loyal to the Shogunate nor drawn to the Imperial cause, you learned to mind your own survival above politics. Travel and hard work taught you practical skills with common weapons and the awareness to avoid unnecessary trouble. In uncertain times, being overlooked has often been your greatest advantage.
